metadata.case_name: YUEN YEUNG KWONG v. NGAI MAN WAH JOE

plaintiff.occupation_before: warehouse worker in cold meat warehouse
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: sedentary/part-time light work such as cashier or watchman

injuries.description: fracture of the shaft of the left distal femur
source: fracture of the shaft of the left distal femur.

injuries.description: open fracture and near amputation of his right tibia and fibula near the ankle
injuries.body_part: right tibia and fibula near the ankle
source: he had an open fracture and near amputation of his right tibia and fibula near the ankle
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot
Injury of other specified muscle, fascia or tendon at ankle or foot level

injuries.description: The right foot appeared ischaemic and there was loss of sensation to the sole
source: The right foot appeared ischaemic and there was loss of sensation to the sole.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of plantar artery of foot

injuries.description: 7-cm laceration over the right side of his back
source: He also had a 7-cm laceration over the right side of his back.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: multiple scars over the reconstructed right leg, and right thigh and left foot (due to skin graft and skin flap harvest)
injuries.body_part: reconstructed right leg, right thigh and left foot
source: He is also left with multiple scars over the reconstructed right leg, and right thigh and left foot (due to skin graft and skin flap harvest).

manifestations.description: severe recurrent pain of the right ankle and foot and the lower leg
numbness of the right ankle and foot and the lower leg
weakness of the right ankle and foot and the lower leg
decreased sensation in the right leg by 30%
decreased sensation in the right foot by 80%
difficulty walking on slopes, stairs or uneven ground
wheelchair-bound for more than 6 months after discharge
depressed, always in a low mood due to the unresolved right leg pain and disabilities
withdrawn and stays at home most of the time; scared of moving traffic

treatments_received: sent to the Accident & Emergency Department of the Princess Margaret Hospital
emergency operation of open reduction and external fixation to treat the right tibia fracture and vascular repair to the tendon
stayed in the Intensive Care Unit for 4 days
transferred to the orthopaedic ward for further management
received a total of 4 operations for the fractures of both legs during hospitalization up to 7 November 2007
on 14 November 2007 he was re-admitted to PMH and underwent 2 more operations of bone graft of the right lower limb fractures and the persistent partial necrosis to skin flap over the right heel
stayed in the hospital for another 3 weeks until 6 December 2007
third admission to PMH for a day on 12 February 2008 for an operation of removal of external fixator
attended intensive physiotherapy during hospitalization and after discharge
tendon repair, nerve graft, skin graft and free vascular flap transfer (reconstruction surgeries)

losses.description: walks with a limping gait, cannot run, difficulty walking on slopes, stairs or uneven ground

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: cannot run or handle heavy weight
multiple scars over the reconstructed right leg, and right thigh and left foot

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: scared of moving traffic and stays at home most of the time
has become withdrawn and stays at home most of the time
